config.notes: Deakin course pages (www.deakin.edu.au/course/<slug>-international is the international view; slugs without -international are the domestic view). Each page has a key-facts strip: "Campus <names> Duration <n> years full-time Intakes Trimesters 1, 2 ... Fees $45,200 for 1 yr full-time AUD". Intakes are printed only as trimester numbers; months come from the published key dates (https://www.deakin.edu.au/study/key-dates and 2027 trimester dates https://www.deakin.edu.au/students/enrolment-and-fees/manage-your-course/handbooks/2027-handbook/2027-trimester-dates): Trimester 1 = March, Trimester 2 = July, Trimester 3 = November (2026: 2 Mar, 6 Jul, 2 Nov; 2027: 1 Mar, 5 Jul, 1 Nov). Honours, Medicine and Dietetics pages say Semester 1/2 with no published month mapping, so they are not read. Fee: only "$X for 1 yr full-time AUD" (international annual); graduate certificate amounts "for 4 credit points" (whole course) and domestic CSP amounts are not read. IELTS: "IELTS overall score of N (with no band score less than M)" in English language requirements.
